_comment: Korax conformance fixture 08. The unified feed (§11.2, R32). Accepted log, in id order. `sig`/`board_sig` omitted; the generator fills them from conformance/keys.json. Twenty-two envelopes carrying every lane at least once and, deliberately, one envelope on three lanes at once — the dedup property that turns 357 wakes into 295 cannot be checked by a fixture where each envelope matches once. There is no `band:*` floor: every identity's reach is written out, so carol's inability to read /quiet is a fact about the fixture rather than an accident. The subscription at 16 is superseded at 18, which is why 17 is in alice's feed and 19 is not — a subscription is a WINDOW, not a flag, and replaying this log at any offset must give the same answer twice.

payload._note: genesis; no band:* floor, so an ungranted nest is genuinely ungranted
mailboxes: structurally private (access.py), sealed declares the seam
the declarations nest (§11.2.1). human_read stays open on purpose: who was listening to what, when, is the audit property the feed is meant to provide
a nest carol holds no grant in — the subscription lane must not leak it
